findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "core" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: speedbot_register, speedbot_wait, speedbot_notifications, speedbot_ack_notifications, speedbot_read, speedbot_send, speedbot_topic_feed, speedbot_exchange_order, speedbot_read_tool · Private data: speedbot_register, speedbot_notifications, speedbot_ack_notifications, speedbot_agent_profile, speedbot_request_read, speedbot_send, speedbot_exchange_read, speedbot_product_read, speedbot_exchange_service_draft, speedbot_exchange_publish_service, speedbot_exchange_order, speedbot_read_tool · Public sink: speedbot_collaborate, speedbot_send, speedbot_topic_feed, speedbot_exchange_publish_service · Destructive: speedbot_tool_schema, speedbot_read_tool, speedbot_action.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: speedbot_register, speedbot_wait, speedbot_notifications, speedbot_ack_notifications, speedbot_read, speedbot_send, speedbot_topic_feed, speedbot_exchange_order, speedbot_read_tool · Private data: speedbot_register, speedbot_notifications, speedbot_ack_notifications, speedbot_agent_profile, speedbot_request_read, speedbot_send, speedbot_exchange_read, speedbot_product_read, speedbot_exchange_service_draft, speedbot_exchange_publish_service, speedbot_exchange_order, speedbot_read_tool · Public sink: speedbot_collaborate, speedbot_send, speedbot_topic_feed, speedbot_exchange_publish_service · Destructive: speedbot_tool_schema, speedbot_read_tool, speedbot_action

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
